title: Scope follow-up due reminders to current ERP user
description: A salesperson opens the existing follow-up due report and sees only reminders for customers in the current ERP data scope. Preserve the existing GET response shape and due-date ordering while requiring the follow-up-due menu grant, resolving the current login on every request, and filtering CustomerFollowUps at the query source with SalespersonDataScopeService. For restricted users, records without a customer ID and customers outside their assignments are invisible; unmapped users receive no rows. Reject invalid aheadDays outside 0 to 365 and fail closed on missing identity or menu access. The existing HTTP operation log provides audit evidence; an error is visible to the report caller. Development only: no schema or migration edits, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused in-memory tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: The existing follow-up-due GET checks current-user identity and its menu grant on each request, rejects invalid aheadDays, and preserves the existing list response for authorized callers.

The report query applies SalespersonDataScopeService before materialization: assigned customer reminders are visible, other and null-customer reminders are hidden for restricted users, and privileged scope retains authorized visibility.
Focused tests cover revoked menu access, unmapped salesperson, reassigned customer, null customer, date bounds, stable due ordering and read-only behavior; safe Release build/test passes.
